prompt: Under Montana's Move Over Law, when you approach a stopped emergency or law enforcement vehicle with flashing lights on a multi-lane road, you must:
options: Sound your horn and continue at the same speed
Move over one lane away if you can do so safely, otherwise slow down
Stop completely until the vehicle leaves
Speed up to clear the area quickly
explanation: The Move Over Law requires you to change one lane away from a stopped emergency, law enforcement, or authorized vehicle displaying flashing lights when it is safe. If you cannot move over, you must slow down and pass with caution.

prompt: A flashing red traffic signal means:
options: Slow down and proceed with caution
The signal is out of order, so speed up
Stop, then proceed when it is safe, as at a stop sign
explanation: A flashing red signal has the same meaning as a stop sign: come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, then proceed when it is safe. A flashing yellow signal means slow down and proceed with caution.
